$comment: Payments for Punkty Systemu (src/server/payments.js, src/engine/payments.js; DECISIONS.md, the payments foundations of 11.11.2026). Off until the author picks the gateway (805) and answers 804–808; the values below are the recommended answers (806 A, 807 A, 808 A) until then. `price`: gross, in grosze, in `currency`. `monthlyLimit`: the most an account pays in the last `limitDays` days, in grosze. `withdrawalDays`: the days after a payment in which unspent bought points can be given back. `adultOnly`: buying only by those who declare they are of age. `termsVersion`: the version of the terms a purchase is accepted under; a new one when the terms change. `pendingHours`: how long an unpaid order waits before it is closed.
